title: Karkar language
description: Eastern Pauwasi language of Papua New Guinea
extract: Karkar, also known as Yuri, is the sole Eastern Pauwasi language of Papua New Guinea. There are about a thousand speakers along the Indonesian border spoken in Green River Rural LLG, Sandaun Province.
